title: Kenshi
details: Steam Workshop Persian localization patch with custom PO tables.
challenges: Engine lacks native Right-to-Left (RTL) text shaping, rendering words in reverse character order.
No support for Persian/Arabic connected cursive glyphs by default.
Missing Persian glyphs in the bundled font atlas (requires injecting custom TTF and Unicode ranges).
limitations: Game UI text wrapping sometimes miscalculates line breaks on non-Latin scripts.
Requires selecting 'fa_IR' explicitly in the game options menu after manual file placement.
installGuide:
1. Download fa_IR.zip from GitHub Releases.
2. Extract it into <Kenshi_Folder>/locale/fa_IR/.
3. Open Kenshi launcher, navigate to Settings > Language, and choose fa_IR.

title: Project Zomboid
details: Full UI, radio, broadcast, and custom Persian font atlas injection.
challenges: Dynamic in-game radio broadcasts and TV subtitles require reverse-engineered timing strings.
Bitmap font atlas regeneration needed to support Persian characters with zero-width non-joiners (ZWNJ).
Item descriptions in Lua tables require UTF-8 without BOM encoding to prevent engine crashes.
limitations: Certain modded items from third-party Steam Workshop mods may fall back to default English.
Font scaling at 4K resolution can require adjusting the game's font size slider.
installGuide:
1. Clone or download the repository.
2. Copy the contents into <ProjectZomboid>/media/lua/shared/Translate/FA/.
3. Launch Project Zomboid and select Farsi/Persian in the Display/Language settings.

title: Darkest Dungeon II
details: Custom Persian glyph shaping & comprehensive game string tables.
challenges: Darkest Dungeon 2 packs localization data into compiled asset bundles requiring binary string replacement.
Custom font assets require TextMeshPro SDF (Signed Distance Field) Persian glyph mapping.
Poedit POT file extraction requires custom parser to preserve narrative token variables.
limitations: Game updates via Steam or Epic Games may overwrite modified string assets, requiring patch re-application.
Voiceover narrator remains in English; only on-screen text, lore, items, and UI are translated.
installGuide:
1. Download the latest release from the ParsiSaz repository.
2. Run the provided patcher or copy the localized string files to the StreamingAssets/Localization directory.
3. Verify game file integrity if you ever wish to revert.

title: Software Inc.
challenges: Over 10,000 corporate, financial, and tech business terms requiring consistent Persian translations.
Dynamic procedural company and software names generated in English grammar syntax.
limitations: Some dynamically combined procedural strings may display English word order.
Compatible with Alpha and Beta branches.
installGuide:
1. Extract Persian folder into <Software_Inc_Folder>/Translations/.
2. In Options > Localization, select 'Persian' from the dropdown list.

title: Oxygen Not Included
details: Klei PO translation tables and custom typography integration.
challenges: Klei PO parser requires strict header formatting and specific UTF-8 character sets.
Complex technical chemical elements, gases, and thermodynamic vocabulary require precise translation.
Font replacement needed for colony resource tags and floating UI tooltips.
limitations: Must be enabled manually in the in-game 'Mods' menu before taking effect.
DLC-specific strings (Spaced Out) are progressively being updated.
installGuide:
1. Download the repo ZIP from GitHub.
2. Extract into %userprofile%\Documents\Klei\OxygenNotIncluded\mods\Local\OxygenNotIncluded_Persian.
3. Start the game, open 'Mods' from the main menu, and enable 'OxygenNotIncluded_Persian'.

title: Stronghold: Warlords
details: Full campaign dialogue and UI localization mod.
challenges: Proprietary text asset encryption across campaign missions.
Font texture sheets require manual character placement for Persian letters.
limitations: Campaign briefing subtitles must be enabled in audio settings.
Historical unit voiceovers remain in original localized audio.
installGuide:
1. Extract the patch into the Stronghold Warlords assets directory.
2. Launch game and verify Persian subtitles in the audio options.

title: Don't Starve Together
details: Custom Persian fonts and interactive item encyclopedia translation.
challenges: Custom font rendering engine requires separate font textures for Persian character sets.
Client and Server mod synchronization required during multiplayer sessions.
limitations: Both host and connecting players should enable the language mod for full synchronization.
Skin items and seasonal festival events may retain original names.
installGuide:
1. Place mod folder into <game_directory>/mods/.
2. Activate the mod in the 'Mods' menu before hosting or joining a server.

title: Stronghold Crusader
details: Historic Persian community voiceover mods & UI patches.
challenges: DirectX 7/8 legacy rendering with ANSI codepage limits (Windows-1256).
Audio format requires exact 22050Hz 16-bit Mono PCM WAV files for soldier voices.
limitations: Designed for legacy releases and Stronghold Crusader HD v1.41.
Preserved primarily for historical and nostalgia preservation.
installGuide:
1. Backup your original crusader directory.
2. Copy the graphics and audio mods over the existing installation.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI

limitations: In active development by community contributors.
Compatible with Gathering Storm expansion.
installGuide:

2. Enable in Additional Content > Mods menu.
